name: Harukawa Hinako
source:
A very easy to understand tsundere. Even when she's using abusive language towards others, her feelings of happiness easily appear on her face.

"You'll be left behind by the world" she says, and worried about [url=/c66243]Tsuzuri[/url] who doesn't use SNS, she meddles in.

She's in a junior-senior relationship with [url=/c66241]Yuzu[/url] in the cooking club. She respects Yuzu for making sweets as good or even better than pros, but often is very anxious about Yuzu who can act in dangerous manner.
